description: Tidio combines live chat and AI-powered chatbots to automate support and lead generation. Marketers can boost conversions and provide instant answers to visitors. See what your customer conversations earn. Lyro resolves questions instantly and turns the rest into sales, leads, and bookings you can attribute. AI chatbots for FAQ and sales automation. Live chat for real-time support. Unified inbox for all conversations. Analytics for chat and conversion rates.

howToUse.title: Register and Install Widget
howToUse.description: Sign up on Tidio and install the chat widget on your website or e-commerce platform.

howToUse.title: Set Up Chatbots and Live Chat
howToUse.description: Configure AI-powered chatbots to answer FAQs, automate lead capture, and handle sales inquiries. Enable live chat for real-time support.

howToUse.title: Customize and Integrate
howToUse.description: Personalize conversation flows, connect with CRM/marketing tools, and use the unified inbox to manage all conversations.

howToUse.title: Analyze and Optimize
howToUse.description: Monitor chat analytics and conversion rates to optimize bot flows and improve customer engagement.
